negative_reviews.author: Halina Zhang
negative_reviews.text:
The ramen broth was quite limited, but it was rich and really tasty. Unfortunately, the prawn tempura was probably the worst I’ve ever had—it wasn’t crispy at all, and the batter was extremely thick.

The waiting time was also far too long. Even though there were plenty of empty tables inside, we were still kept waiting at the door for ages. Surprisingly, such a large restaurant only had two members of staff working during the busy dinner rush. That being said, they both provided great service.

negative_reviews.author: Sophia SIU
negative_reviews.text:
I and my family members visited on last Saturday night. Not much people on that night, therefore we just needed to be wait for about 5-10 minutes for the table.

We ordered a black garlic tonkotsu ramen. We were shocked as the ramen served to us with such little amount of soup . We preferred that the ramen should be served with at least half bowel of soup.

We also ordered rainbow roll and sushi set. The food tastes good and fresh .

However, we were shocked again that they automatically adds a service charge to the bill. We enquired to the waitress and she confirmed us we have to pay the bill with service charge .

In summary, the food was fine. Instead the price shows on the menu ,please pay attention they also have 10% service charges.

negative_reviews.author: farial mahmud
negative_reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Maki & Ramen Meadowhall on Saturday 15 August, shortly after 6:30 pm.

We visited as a family with our very young daughter and had brought a small amount of fried chicken for her because she would not eat the restaurant food.

A staff member told us outside food was not allowed due to allergy/cross-contamination concerns. We would have completely respected the policy if it had simply been explained politely.

Instead, the staff member was rude and condescending, continued lecturing us, and made a sarcastic comparison that bringing food for our toddler was like “going to a shoe shop with shoes.”

The way we were treated made us feel singled out and uncomfortable, and honestly ruined the whole meal for us. After that interaction, we could not relax or enjoy the food at all.

The behaviour also left us wondering whether we were being treated differently from other customers.

Restaurant policies are understandable, but customers should still be treated with basic respect.

I emailed Maki & Ramen management about this on 20 August and have not received a response yet.
